12th pass or ITI/Diploma. Age 18-27. Trade test for Technician.

stages.name: Written Exam / GATE
stages.tests: Technical MCQs: OS, DBMS, Networks, Programming, Data Structures. 100-200 Qs.

stages.name: Technical Interview
stages.tests: 20-30 min. Technical questions, project discussion, problem-solving.
stages.note: Focus on core CS subjects and practical experience.

stages.name: Skill Test / Coding

stages.name: Document Verification
stages.tests: Degree, marksheets, caste, NOC, experience certificates.

reality: PSU IT jobs (BEL, HAL, BHEL) require GATE score. ISRO/DRDO have own exams.
Government IT salaries are lower than private sector but job security is higher.
NIC (National Informatics Centre) is the largest government IT employer.
DRDO/ISRO require B.Tech with high CGPA. Research background preferred.
Coding tests are becoming common for government IT roles. Practice LeetCode.
Age relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years. PwD 10 years.

syllabus.pattern: Computer-based test on core computer science plus general aptitude, followed by an interview. NIC publishes the exact pattern and marking in each advertisement — read it before you prepare.

topics.items: Data structures, algorithms and complexity, operating systems, DBMS, computer networks, software engineering, programming (C, C++, Java), web technologies, computer architecture
Discrete mathematics, probability, linear algebra, numerical methods

syllabus.books: GATE CS Guide (Amazon) · Flipkart

syllabus.pattern: Written test on the core engineering discipline at degree level — computer science, electronics, mechanical, civil or the branch advertised — followed by an interview. No general-knowledge section.

topics.items: For CS: data structures, algorithms, OS, DBMS, networks, theory of computation, compilers, digital logic, computer organisation, software engineering
ISRO tests depth, not breadth — numericals from the core subjects dominate

syllabus.pattern: Computer-based test on the discipline plus aptitude, shortlisting for interview. Weightage between discipline and aptitude is stated in the DRDO/RAC advertisement.

topics.items: Core engineering or science of the advertised post at degree level

syllabus.pattern: Prelims: 150 questions, 125 marks, 120 minutes — Reasoning 50, English 50, Quantitative Aptitude 50. Mains: Professional Knowledge 60 questions, 60 marks, 45 minutes.

topics.items: DBMS, networking, operating systems, data structures, web technologies, software engineering, information security, basic banking technology
Reasoning, English and quantitative aptitude at IBPS prelims standard

faq.q: Can I get a government IT job without GATE?
faq.a: Yes. NIC, SSC JE (IT), UPSC IES (for engineers) don't require GATE. PSUs like BEL, HAL, BHEL prefer GATE but some have own exams.

faq.q: What is the salary for government IT jobs?
faq.a: Scientist-B (ISRO/DRDO): ~₹56,100 (Level 10). Probationary Engineer (BEL): ~₹40,000-50,000. NIC Scientist: ~₹56,100. Plus DA, HRA, allowances.

faq.q: Is coding required for government IT jobs?
faq.a: For developer roles (NIC, ISRO), yes. For system admin/network roles, less coding but strong fundamentals. DEO roles require typing, not coding.

faq.q: How competitive are government IT jobs?
faq.a: ISRO: 1-2 lakh applicants for 300-500 vacancies. NIC: 50,000+ for 500-1000. BEL/HAL: 1-2 lakh for 100-300. Very competitive.

faq.q: What qualifications are needed for government IT jobs?
faq.a: B.Tech/MCA for scientist/engineer roles. Diploma/ITI for technician roles. 12th pass for DEO. Some PSUs accept M.Sc (Computer Science).

faq.q: Where do I find official IT job notifications?
faq.a: nic.in, isro.gov.in, drdo.gov.in, bel-india.in, hal-india.co.in, bhel.com. SarkariJobs+ links the official notification on every listing.

prepPlan.what: ISRO, DRDO and NIC test the degree syllabus at GATE level. Pick four subjects that carry the most questions — data structures, algorithms, DBMS and operating systems for CS — and finish them properly before touching aptitude.
These exams ask numericals, not definitions. Solve previous-year papers of ISRO, DRDO and NIC; the same subject areas repeat. Keep a formula and complexity sheet.
Aptitude is a small section but a common cut-off failure. Thirty minutes daily is enough for IBPS SO prelims and DRDO aptitude.
One full mock a week under timing, then analyse by subject. For IBPS SO, add sectional tests for professional knowledge.
Prepare your final-year project, internship and any published work — DRDO, ISRO and NIC interviews spend most of the time there. Revise the core subjects you listed on the application form.
